info.title: Revcenter API
info.description: Projects, searches, scored candidates and shortlists. Generated from the agent API's registry.

get.description: Whether the API is up. No key needed. Does not use shortlist credits.

post.description: Start a device login, for a machine with no browser. Show the person verification_uri_complete and user_code, then poll POST /auth/token every interval seconds. No key needed. Does not use shortlist credits.

client_name.description: Shown on the approval page, and the new key's default name.

post.description: Trade a sign-in for a key, returned once. A browser sign-in sends grant_type authorization_code with the code from the loopback redirect, its PKCE code_verifier and the same redirect_uri. A device login polls with device_code: authorization_pending (or slow_down) until someone authorizes it at /oauth/device. Errors: access_denied, expired_token, invalid_grant. No key needed. Does not use shortlist credits.

grant_type.description: authorization_code for a browser sign-in; omit (or device_code) to poll a device login.

code.description: The rvca_ code the browser brought to redirect_uri.

code_verifier.description: The PKCE verifier whose S256 challenge opened /oauth/authorize.

redirect_uri.description: The loopback address the code was sent to, exactly.

data.name: launch_search
data.summary: Start a LinkedIn search in a project.

post.description:
What an action would do and spend, without doing it; returns a proposal_id that apply_proposal runs within 30 minutes. Works for every action marked proposable in GET /actions. Previewing a requirement change re-scores nothing until it is applied, except that its before/after is computed on the people already read. Does not use shortlist credits.

Needs scope `searches:read`.

action.description: A proposable action name, e.g. launch_search.

input.description: The action's own arguments: path ids (project_id, search_id, candidate_id) and its body fields.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests allowed this minute (the tighter of the key's and the workspace's).

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: When the minute resets, in Unix seconds.

post.description:
Run an action previewed with preview_action, exactly as previewed. Applying the same proposal twice returns the first result. The key needs the scope of the action the proposal runs, too. Uses what its preview stated: 1 shortlist credit for a search or an expansion, nothing for anything else.

Needs scope `searches:read`.

post.description:
Start a LinkedIn search in a project, on `criteria` run exactly as sent, or on a `jd_text` Revcenter reads; with database_only it scores the workspace's candidates on file and uses no credit. Send an Idempotency-Key: a retry with the same key, project and body returns the same search; the same key on a different request returns 409 idempotency_key_reused. Uses 1 shortlist credit.

Needs scope `searches:write`.

database_only.description: Search only the workspace's candidates on file. Uses no shortlist credit.
